name: Helez
title: One of David's Mighty Men
summary: Helez (also called Helez the Pelethite or Helez the Pelonite) was one of King David's mighty warriors, known as 'the Thirty'. He served as a commander in the monthly rotation system during David's reign and led the division for the seventh month.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's Mighty Men
keyEvents.description: Helez the Pelonite is listed among David's mighty men, the thirty heroes who fought faithfully for the king.

keyEvents.title: Leader of the Seventh Month's Division
keyEvents.description: Helez from Pelet was appointed leader of the army division that served in the seventh month, with 24,000 men under his command.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the Register of Heroes in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Helez the Pelonite is also mentioned in the parallel list of David's heroes in 1 Chronicles, among the sons of Ephraim.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's Military Organization
keyEvents.description: As part of David's administrative system, Helez served in the monthly rotation that ensured the kingdom always had a standing army ready.
